name: cll-equivalence-progressive
description: Balanced local CLL equivalence and scaling measurements across targets, trees, and thread budgets.
limitations: The suite demonstrates computational equivalence under explicit numeric tolerances; it makes no claim about biological accuracy.
Target subsets are deterministic nested samples of expression genes and are intended for engineering measurements, not biological feature selection.
Four measured pairs balance reference/candidate execution order and support descriptive paired intervals; they are not publication-grade inferential evidence.
Run one or a few representative --dataset selections before expanding to every prepared patient/type unit.

cases.description: Target-count scaling with fixed trees and thread budget.
Tree-count scaling with a fixed bounded target set.
Thread scaling at a fixed target and tree workload.
Combined 320-target and 250-tree measurement point for non-linear batching or memory effects.
